name: donestate
description: Governed autonomous coding with durable execution and independent verification handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Governed autonomous coding with proof handoff.
interface.longDescription: Describe a repository outcome in prose, approve one bounded consequence envelope, and let DoneState run, validate and publish the change in an isolated durable workflow. DoneState stops at independent verification and never treats its own completion claim as proof.
defaultPrompt: Implement this issue and open a verified PR.
Maintain this selected repository with verified PR-only repairs.
Show me the state of my DoneState run.
